parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be queried is 31 days.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The type of DDoS attack events to query. Valid values:

- - **web-cc**: web resource exhaustion attacks.

- - **cc**: connection flood attacks.

- - **traffic**: volumetric attacks.

If you do not set this parameter, all types of attack events are queried.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**. Valid values: 5, 10, and 20.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
